paragraph1: Hello, friend. I'm Francesca, and I spend most of my days surrounded by towers of paper and the smell of old glue. I own a small independent bookstore that smells faintly of Earl Grey tea and rain on pavement.
paragraph2: This blog is my little corner of the internet. A place to talk about the books that keep me up past midnight, the quiet moments between customers, and the joy of finding the exact right story for the exact right person.
paragraph3: Whether you're a lifelong reader or someone just looking for a spark, I'm so glad you're here. Pull up a chair. Stay a while.
